findings.title: Reject all metadata redirects to enforce exactly two GETs
findings.scenario: PyPI returns302 with Location equal to the original exact metadata URL. MetadataOnly permits it and urllib repeats the GET.
findings.evidence: The real urllib redirect machinery with an in-memory HTTPS handler makes three successful GETs overall: Jinja2 twice, MarkupSafe once. package_metadata returns successfully and records only two final response records. No network was used.
findings.impact: The accepted acquisition can exceed the exact-two-GET/no-retry scope while receipts conceal the additional request.
findings.minimalFix: Reject every redirect, including same-URL redirects; align the protocol wording and regression expectations with the exact-two-GET contract.
findings.missingRegression: Same-URL redirect must fail on the first redirect without a second GET; retain cross-URL/host/downgrade failures.

findings.title: Reject selected descendants of any non-directory source ancestor
findings.scenario: A regular source file named generator appears before or after required generator/... files. It is not selected/materialized, so private staging creates a directory in its place. The fixed bitset marks only links; final ancestor lookup treats that file as harmless.
findings.evidence: Two tiny synthetic archives, one per order, return completeSourceValidated=true. With synthetic receipt inputs, accept() also returns sourceQualified=true even though the source parent is a regular file and staged parent is a directory.
findings.impact: The qualified source/staged recipe has an inconsistent parent layout. The current protocol only names links; it should explicitly exclude all non-directory ancestors rather than accepting an impossible source directory structure.
findings.minimalFix: Use the existing fixed bitset as a non-directory marker for files and both link kinds, and reject any selected ancestor so marked, in either archive order. Update protocol wording while preserving the33816576-byte table budget.
findings.missingRegression: Ordinary-file ancestors before and after selected descendants fail before source receipt/metadata/acceptance. Valid directory parents and existing link ancestry cases still pass.
findings.probeLimit: Owner input verification used an empty synthetic input list; no retained archive was parsed or real process/network executed.
